description.value: Rossland Beer Company is an award-winning craft brewery and tasting room in Rossland, BC, producing small-batch beers including the Canadian Brewing Award gold-medal-winning Seven Summits Milk Stout and the BC Beer Award-winning Paydirt Pale Ale. The tasting room overlooks the brewing operation and opens onto a sunny patio, drawing outdoor enthusiasts directly from Rossland's world-class mountain bike trails and ski slopes. The brewery actively sponsors local mountain biking athletes and is deeply embedded in the town's adventure-sports culture, making it a natural gathering point for touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and provides strong evidence. The about page confirms the business is an active craft brewery and tasting room with a sunny patio at 1990F Columbia Ave, corroborating OSM location but with a unit-number discrepancy (OSM: '1990-A'; website: '1990F'). No explicit mention of bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging was found in any page of the website content.
